W.note: A clean violet-to-magenta gradient drifts on hover with a bloom halo and shimmer, but animating letter-spacing reflows the label, and the rest-state screenshot shows stray light smears on the button and the ghost label.

X.note: The most complete system: separate face and glow curves with 420 ms in and 700 ms out, a named rebound preset, live contrast and overshoot checks, and focus parity, though the lab-heavy page is busier than a marketing site.

Y.note: The aurora-gradient stage gives the most ethereal whole-page feel, with a lingering glow and checked curves, and the solid navy primary keeps the label legible; the glass variant drops its glow and the mobile note pill wraps awkwardly.

Z.note: The richest dreamlike vocabulary (aura, sheen, looping motes, 1.1 to 1.6 s glides) on an editorial layout, but white labels on the rose and mint states fail contrast, the sky focus ring is faint on lavender, and the hover crop missed the button, so the hover evidence is weak.
